project._comment: From the prebuilt title block and execution plan. 'auteur' appears on the cover as 'Ontwikkeld door'.
project.omschrijving: <what is drilled, pipe, hole diameter, rig side>

grondonderzoek._comment: Where the soil data comes from; printed in chapter 2.4. bron: sondering | boring | dov | bureaustudie
grondonderzoek.referentie: <CPT/boring id, DOV kern nr, or map sheet used>
grondonderzoek.omschrijving: <1-3 sentences: geology of the site, which formations, why these parameters>

leiding._comment: type 'buis' (HDPE pipe, NEN 3650 checks) or 'kabel' (bare cable: pull-force + bend-radius check, t_mm = Do/2). SDR11: t = Do/11. E_buiging 0 = Deltares convention for PE. buigstraal_plaatsing_xD from datasheet (PE100 SDR11: 12). kromtestraal_min_m null = estimate from prebuilt.

boorvloeistof._comment: Hole diameters in m: pilot head / pilot rods, pre-reamer / rods, final reamer / product pipe is taken from leiding.Do_mm. Ask the driller. werkdruk_bar = reference pump pressure at the rig (informative line in graphs); typical BE field value 1.8-2.0 bar.

_README: Template. Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored. Copy to config_<project>.json and fill in. Units: m TAW for levels, kN/m2 for stresses, mm for pipe dimensions, m for hole diameters.
_grondwaterstand_mTAW: Groundwater level in m TAW, or null for no phreatic line. Valley sites: typically 1-3 m below the lowest ground level.
_grondlagen: Ordered top->bottom. top_mTAW 999 = ground level. gedraineerd true = sand/silt (phi, c); false = clay undrained (su). E in kN/m2 (MPa x 1000). Typical values: leem 12-20 MPa phi 27-30 c 3-5 | fijn zand 25-40 MPa phi 30-33 | stijf zand 60-100 MPa phi 35-38 | Ieper/Kortrijk klei su 60-120 kPa E 15-25 MPa.
_intrekrichting: 'A->B' = rig at A (entry A). Put the rig at the LOW end of the bore so returns flow downhill; swap the prebuilt or set 'B->A'.
